items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: and we used to practice in Louis Armstrong's band practically every day.

ctx.x: He told me the other day that he was going to come by and see youx because he hadn't been by in a long time.

Any time he knows where I'm playing. He'll do it every time. ... and we used to practice in Louis Armstrong's band practically every day. We weren't doing anything, I'd say, OK, let's play. He loved to play. And, can play.
How about, tell me something in the many, many years that you've been playing the trombone you do feel you've gotten better playing? Has your playing improved since 1929?
